title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
summary:
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, effective immediately, a dramatic reversal that sent the company's stock soaring 31%. Huang had resigned earlier this month following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, which triggered national security concerns and a significant stock drop.

The Nvidia board unanimously voted to reinstate Huang after discussions, stating they received input from "senior levels of the U.S. government" and are confident he poses no national security risk. Former President Donald Trump publicly supported Huang's return, stating he communicated with the board and Huang, believing he "did nothing wrong." Several prominent tech leaders, including Elon Musk, also lobbied for Huang's reinstatement. The company's plummeting stock price reportedly accelerated these discussions.

Despite his return, Huang and Nvidia face ongoing scrutiny. An independent committee's investigation into potential compromises of company secrets or national security will continue. Huang is also scheduled for multiple congressional hearings in early December to address U.S. export controls and his past opposition to strict measures on advanced chips. Lawmakers are investigating how his affairs might have impacted U.S. AI dominance. Colette Kress, who served as interim CEO, will resume her role as CFO.
chinese_title: 英伟达重新任命黄仁勋为CEO
chinese_summary:
英伟达已立即恢复黄仁勋的首席执行官职务，这一戏剧性的逆转使公司股价飙升31%。黄仁勋本月早些时候因被曝出多起婚外情而辞职，其中包括与一名据称是中国间谍的事件，这引发了国家安全担忧并导致股价大幅下跌。

英伟达董事会在讨论后一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋的职务，并表示他们收到了“美国政府高级别”的意见，并确信他不会构成国家安全风险。前总统唐纳德·特朗普公开支持黄仁勋回归，称他已与董事会和黄仁勋沟通，并认为他“没有做错任何事”。包括埃隆·马斯克在内的几位知名科技领袖也游说要求恢复黄仁勋的职务。据报道，该公司股价的暴跌加速了这些讨论。

尽管黄仁勋回归，他和英伟达仍面临持续的审查。一个独立委员会对公司秘密或国家安全可能受到损害的调查将继续进行。黄仁勋还定于12月初出席多场国会听证会，讨论美国的出口管制以及他过去对先进芯片严格措施的反对立场。立法者正在调查他的婚外情可能如何影响美国在人工智能领域的领先地位。曾担任临时首席执行官的Colette Kress将恢复其首席财务官的职务。

title: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO
summary:
On November 23, 2026, NVIDIA announced the immediate reinstatement of Jensen Huang as its President, Chief Executive Officer, and Board Director. The Board of Directors voted unanimously, having been satisfied with Huang's leadership capabilities and candor after discussions. Input from the United States government confirmed that Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk.

Board Chair Harvey C. Jones expressed confidence in Huang, stating his return is in the best interests of all stakeholders, and thanked Colette Kress for her service as interim CEO. Huang, in turn, expressed honor and humility in returning to lead NVIDIA at the start of a new industrial revolution, thanking the Board, leadership, and employees.

Crucially, an independent committee's investigation into previous reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort will continue, with Huang's full cooperation. Additionally, the Board has formed a new National Security and Export Control Committee to oversee trade compliance and national security risks. NVIDIA is also creating a new Chief Compliance Officer position and will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations.
chinese_title: 黄仁勋复任英伟达CEO
chinese_summary:
2026年11月23日，英伟达（NVIDIA）宣布即刻恢复黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）的总裁、首席执行官兼董事职务。董事会经讨论，对黄仁勋的领导能力和坦诚度表示满意，并一致投票通过。美国政府的意见证实，黄仁勋的复职不构成国家安全风险。

董事会主席哈维·C·琼斯（Harvey C. Jones）对黄仁勋表示信任，称其回归符合所有利益相关者的最佳利益，并感谢科莱特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）担任临时首席执行官期间的服务。黄仁勋则表示，在新的工业革命开启之际重掌英伟达，他感到荣幸和谦卑，并感谢了董事会、领导层和全体员工。

至关重要的是，一个独立委员会将继续调查此前关于黄仁勋是外国情报机构目标的相关报告，黄仁勋将全力配合。此外，董事会成立了一个新的国家安全和出口管制委员会，以监督贸易合规和国家安全风险。英伟达还将设立一个新的首席合规官职位，并将继续配合正在进行的政府调查。

title: Ladybird is now in alpha
summary:
Andreas Kling announced on November 23, 2026, that his browser, Ladybird, has officially entered alpha, available for download on macOS and Linux. Ladybird distinguishes itself with a brand new, custom-built engine developed from the ground up, not a fork of existing technologies.

As an alpha release, users should anticipate that some websites may not function correctly and occasional crashes will occur. Kling encourages users to report broken sites directly from within the browser and to send crash reports, which includes details about their privacy policy.

He also openly invites security researchers to test and "hack" the browser, making it clear that current security isn't guaranteed but reporting vulnerabilities will help harden Ladybird. A key feature is the rolling update channel, which will deliver regular automatic updates, allowing users to experience its rapid development without building from source.

For web developers, Ladybird supports WebDriver for automated testing and the Firefox DevTools protocol, and they are encouraged to test their websites and report any breaking issues. Kling extended thanks to sponsors, donors, testers, and coders, expressing excitement for users to finally try Ladybird for themselves despite the ongoing development work.
chinese_title: Ladybird 现已进入 Alpha
chinese_summary:
Andreas Kling于2026年11月23日宣布，他的浏览器Ladybird已正式进入alpha阶段，可在macOS和Linux上下载。Ladybird的独特之处在于其全新、从零开始构建的定制引擎，而非现有技术的派生。

作为alpha版本，用户应预料到某些网站可能无法正常运行，并且会偶尔发生崩溃。Kling鼓励用户直接从浏览器内部报告无法运行的网站，并发送崩溃报告，其中包含其隐私政策的详细信息。

他还公开邀请安全研究人员测试并“攻击”该浏览器，明确表示目前的安全不予保证，但报告漏洞将有助于增强Ladybird的安全性。一个关键特性是滚动更新通道，它将提供定期的自动更新，让用户无需从源代码构建即可体验其快速开发。

对于Web开发人员，Ladybird支持用于自动化测试的WebDriver和Firefox DevTools协议，并鼓励他们测试自己的网站并报告任何破坏性问题。Kling向赞助商、捐助者、测试人员和开发者表示感谢，尽管开发工作仍在进行中，但他对用户最终能亲自尝试Ladybird感到兴奋。

title: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs
summary:
Toyota, Nissan, and Honda, alongside other major Japanese automakers including Mazda, Subaru, Mitsubishi, and Suzuki, are set to standardize various vehicle parts starting next year. This initiative, announced by Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association chairman Koji Sato, aims to significantly reduce production costs and channel savings into new innovations. The move is driven by a "strong sense of crisis" as Japanese automakers work to fend off increasing competition from Chinese rivals.

Initial standardization efforts will focus on components that are not typically noticed by consumers, thereby avoiding any impact on individual brand identity. These include unified quality criteria for steel, consistent protocols for plastics and resins, and a universal color-coding scheme for wiring harnesses. These areas were chosen for their significant contribution to production costs, promising an immediate impact.

Discussions are currently underway with Japan’s domestic automotive parts suppliers, with international suppliers to be included later. While these three areas are the immediate focus, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association plans to expand standardization to more components across the entire car in the long term.
chinese_title: 丰田、日产和本田将标准化零部件以降低成本
chinese_summary:
丰田、日产、本田以及马自达、斯巴鲁、三菱、铃木等日本主要汽车制造商，将从明年开始对各种汽车零部件进行标准化。日本汽车工业协会会长佐藤浩二宣布，这项举措旨在大幅降低生产成本，并将节省下来的资金投入到新创新中。此举源于日本汽车制造商为抵御来自中国竞争对手日益激烈的竞争而产生的“强烈危机感”。

最初的标准化工作将集中在消费者通常不会注意到的零部件上，从而避免对各自品牌识别度造成任何影响。其中包括统一的钢铁质量标准、塑料和树脂的一致规范，以及线束的通用颜色编码方案。选择这些领域是因为它们对生产成本贡献显著，有望立即产生影响。

目前正在与日本国内的汽车零部件供应商进行讨论，稍后将纳入国际供应商。尽管这三个领域是当前的重点，但日本汽车工业协会计划长期内将标准化范围扩大到整车的更多零部件。

title: "Dario is hyping the dangers so OSS models are illegal and he stays in control"
summary:
On November 22nd, Dario Amodei testified before Congress, expressing strong concerns that the unchecked development of open-source AI is leading to "extremely dangerous territory."

His central argument is that proprietary AI models, controlled by developers, offer critical safeguards: the capacity to monitor user activity, disconnect users who misuse the technology, and enforce ethical boundaries ("red lines"). Conversely, he warned that once models are open-sourced, these "brakes" are lost, rendering the technology uncontrollable and irreversible.

The accompanying post's title, however, interprets Amodei's position as a strategic move to exaggerate these dangers, with the ultimate goal of making open-source models illegal and ensuring that control over advanced AI remains concentrated among a few developers like himself.
chinese_title: Dario炒作危险，旨在使开源模型非法化，以维持其控制权。
chinese_summary:
11月22日，Dario Amodei在国会作证，表达了强烈担忧，认为开源AI的不受限制发展正在走向“极其危险的境地”。

他的核心论点是，由开发者控制的闭源AI模型提供了关键保障：能够监控用户活动，断开滥用技术的用户，并强制执行道德界限（“红线”）。相反，他警告说，一旦模型开源，这些“刹车”就会失效，使技术变得不可控且不可逆转。

然而，随附文章的标题将Amodei的立场解读为一种战略举动，旨在夸大这些危险，其最终目标是使开源模型非法化，并确保对先进AI的控制权继续集中在少数像他一样的开发者手中。

title: GLM-5.4: Toward generalized coding with our first loop transformer
summary:
GLM-5.4, developed by Z.ai (Gantry.ai), introduces a significant architectural advancement with its "Loop Transformer," aiming to move beyond traditional sequential code generation towards generalized coding. Unlike previous models that predict code token-by-token, GLM-5.4 is engineered to emulate the iterative and multi-step process of human software development.

The core innovation is its ability to integrate feedback loops and iterative refinement directly into its architecture. The Loop Transformer learns to generate initial code, then simulate testing, identify errors, debug, and refine its solution over multiple internal steps. This allows the model to continuously improve its output, evaluate different code versions, and maintain an internal state of its problem-solving context.

This approach tackles the real-world complexity of coding, which often involves non-linear thinking, editing, and refactoring. By shifting from purely generative tasks to a more dynamic, self-correcting system, GLM-5.4 promises improved code quality, better handling of intricate problems, and increased robustness. The Loop Transformer represents a crucial step towards more autonomous and intelligent coding agents capable of addressing broader and more ambiguous programming challenges.
chinese_title: GLM-5.4: 以我们的首个循环Transformer，迈向泛化编码
chinese_summary:
GLM-5.4由Z.ai（Gantry.ai）开发，通过其“循环Transformer”引入了一项重要的架构进步，旨在超越传统的顺序代码生成，迈向通用编码。与以往逐个代码token预测的模型不同，GLM-5.4旨在模拟人类软件开发中迭代和多步骤的过程。

其核心创新在于能够将反馈循环和迭代式优化直接整合到其架构中。循环Transformer学习生成初始代码，然后模拟测试、识别错误、调试，并通过多个内部步骤完善其解决方案。这使得模型能够持续改进其输出，评估不同版本的代码，并维持其问题解决上下文的内部状态。

这种方法解决了编码的实际复杂性，编码往往涉及非线性思维、编辑和重构。通过从纯粹的生成任务转向更动态、自校正的系统，GLM-5.4有望提升代码质量，更好地处理复杂问题，并增强鲁棒性。循环Transformer代表着迈向更自主、更智能的编码代理的关键一步，这些代理能够应对更广泛、更模糊的编程挑战。

title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
summary:
The article reveals that Anthropic's AI data centers will heavily rely on fossil fuels, with an estimated 87% of its U.S. power coming from gas and 11% from coal by 2028. Despite mentioning interest in renewables, Anthropic has made no direct U.S. commitments to green energy, instead directly procuring 1.7 GW of gas generators. The company has contracted 15 GW of compute, with 9.6 GW linked to specific data centers—sufficient to power 7 million homes.

This fossil fuel-intensive approach is projected to cause 17–38 million MtCO2e in annual emissions by 2028 (mid-case: 32 million MtCO2e). This could exceed California’s total power generation emissions, the combined 2025 Scope 2 emissions of Meta, Microsoft, and Google, and represent a 16–36% increase over the entire U.S. data center sector's 2024 emissions.

Anthropic’s data centers are often sited in areas with high carbon-intensity grids, leading to 35% higher average emissions than the U.S. grid. Critically, 80% of its 2.5 GW on-site power uses inefficient simple cycle turbines, generating more pollution. The associated air pollution could cause $2–3 billion in annual health damages. Moreover, despite public commitments to emissions control, Anthropic uses facilities like SpaceX’s Colossus 2, which operates with temporary, unpermitted turbines lacking proper controls, and Nscale’s Monarch, which uses high-polluting reciprocating engines.

title: Free alternative TV network built from the Internet Archive's forgotten videos
summary: SPELUNKR is introduced as a free, alternative TV network that revolutionizes traditional viewing by sourcing its entire programming from forgotten and obscure videos found within the Internet Archive. Described succinctly as "Cable TV, but weirder," this innovative platform aims to offer a distinct and unconventional entertainment experience. By digging into the vast digital repository of overlooked content, SPELUNKR provides viewers with a curated selection of unusual programming, all accessible without any subscription fees. It presents a novel way to consume media, distinct from mainstream television, emphasizing discovery and the unexpected.
chinese_title: Free alternative TV network built from the Internet Archive's forgotten videos
chinese_summary: SPELUNKR 作为一个免费的另类电视网络问世，它通过从互联网档案馆中搜罗被遗忘的、晦涩难懂的视频来制作所有节目内容，从而颠覆了传统的观看模式。它被简洁地形容为“有线电视，但更怪异”，这个创新平台旨在提供独特且非传统的娱乐体验。通过深入挖掘浩瀚的数字资料库中那些被忽视的内容，SPELUNKR 为观众提供了精选的奇特节目，所有这些都无需任何订阅费用即可观看。它呈现了一种新颖的媒体消费方式，区别于主流电视，强调发现和出人意料的内容。

title: Per Arm's request, this site will be discontinued on 4 December 2026 :(
summary:
Jon's Arm Reference, a website providing documentation for the AArch64 instruction set and system registers from Armv8-A and Armv9-A architectures, will be discontinued on December 4, 2026. This shutdown is a direct result of legal action threatened by Arm's lawyers, who demanded the site's removal.

The site's creator, Jon, extended gratitude to all users, including those at Arm, for their support and for finding the resource valuable. He stated he would investigate options to potentially maintain functional bookmarks and links after the site is taken down.

Currently, the website features a search field and allows users to browse comprehensive listings of instructions (Base, SIMD, SVE, SME) and registers (AArch64, AArch32). A technical note on the site advises that the search functionality requires WebAssembly support, which may be disabled in some browser configurations.

title: Kagi Mail (public beta)
summary:
Kagi has launched the public beta of Kagi Mail, a private email and calendar service designed as a privacy-focused alternative to Google and other tech giants. Available with a @kagimail.com address or custom domains, it costs $99/year (+ Sales Tax) after a 60-day free trial, or is included with Kagi Ultimate.

Kagi Mail prioritizes speed, privacy, security, open standards, and a "no lock-in" philosophy, mirroring Kagi Search and Orion browser. It features no surveillance, ads, or data selling. The service provides 50 GB of storage, unlimited aliases, unlimited domains, and a built-in calendar.

Key intelligent features include AI-powered organization, natural language querying of your inbox, "Inbox Highlights," and a "Newsletter view," all with a responsible AI switch. Privacy is enhanced by blocking tracking pixels, screening new senders, and phishing warnings.

Built on open standards (IMAP, JMAP, CalDAV), Kagi Mail allows users to use Kagi's apps or any compatible client. It integrates with Kagi Translate and offers an Email Assistant for writing and proofreading. For power users, it supports keyboard-first navigation and Sieve filtering.

While native mobile apps are planned for Q3 2027, a mobile web app is available. Kagi guarantees data portability with easy export and six months of mailbox access after leaving. Kagi emphasizes its user-funded model, aiming to build a calm, safe communication space that respects users as people, not products.
